mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sys_article_like WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND article_id = #{articleId}
mapper.select:
SELECT a.id, a.user_id, a.title, a.summary, a.cover, a.content_md, a.quantity, a.is_stick, a.create_time, u.nickname, u.avatar FROM sys_article a LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON a.user_id = u.id WHERE a.status = 1
AND a.id in (SELECT article_id FROM sys_article_tag WHERE tag_id = #{tagId})
AND a.id in (SELECT article_id FROM sys_article_category WHERE category_id = #{categoryId})
AND a.title like concat('%',#{keyword},'%')
order by a.is_stick desc, a.create_time desc

SELECT a.id, a.user_id, a.title, a.summary, a.cover, a.content_md, a.content, a.quantity, a.is_stick, a.read_type, a.create_time, a.is_original, a.original_url, a.ai_describe, u.nickname, u.avatar, (SELECT COUNT(sc.id) FROM sys_comment sc WHERE sc.article_id = a.id) AS commentNum, (SELECT COUNT(sal.id) FROM sys_article_like sal WHERE sal.article_id = a.id) AS likeNum FROM sys_article a LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON a.user_id = u.id where a.id = #{id}
SELECT DATE_FORMAT( create_time, '%Y' ) AS YEAR FROM sys_article WHERE status = 1 GROUP BY YEAR order by YEAR desc
select id,title,create_time from sys_article where status = 1 and DATE_FORMAT( create_time, '%Y' ) = #{year} order by create_time desc

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.summary, a.cover, a.is_stick, a.is_recommend, a.quantity, a.status, a.create_time, u.nickname, u.avatar FROM sys_article a left join sys_user u on a.user_id = u.id
a.status = #{query.status}
and a.title like concat('%',#{query.title},'%')
AND a.id in (SELECT article_id FROM sys_article_category WHERE category_id = #{query.categoryId})
AND a.id in (SELECT article_id FROM sys_article_tag WHERE tag_id = #{query.tagId})
order by a.is_stick desc, a.create_time desc
SELECT DATE_FORMAT( create_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ) AS `date`, COUNT( id ) AS count FROM sys_article WHERE date(create_time) >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR) group by `date` order by `date` asc
SELECT COUNT( id ) > 0 AS isLike FROM sys_article_like WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND article_id = #{articleId}

SELECT c.name AS name, COUNT(DISTINCT sac.article_id) AS value FROM sys_category c LEFT JOIN sys_article_category sac ON c.id = sac.category_id LEFT JOIN sys_article a ON sac.article_id = a.id AND a.status = 1 GROUP BY c.id, c.name

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.summary, a.cover, a.content_md, a.quantity, a.is_stick, a.create_time FROM sys_article a left join sys_article_like sal on a.id = sal.article_id WHERE sal.user_id = #{userId} order by a.is_stick desc, a.create_time desc

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.summary, a.cover, a.content_md, a.quantity, a.is_stick, a.status, a.create_time, GROUP_CONCAT(c.name SEPARATOR ', ') AS category, (SELECT COUNT(sc.id) FROM sys_comment sc WHERE sc.article_id = a.id) AS commentNum, (SELECT COUNT(sal.id) FROM sys_article_like sal WHERE sal.article_id = a.id) AS likeNum FROM sys_article a LEFT JOIN sys_article_category sac ON a.id = sac.article_id LEFT JOIN sys_category c ON sac.category_id = c.id WHERE a.user_id = #{article.userId} GROUP BY a.id
AND a.status = #{article.status}
AND a.title like concat('%',#{article.title},'%')
order by a.is_stick desc, a.create_time desc
